title: What federal MOUs do, and where their power stops
adds: 'An MOU records how offices will use powers they already have together: who leads, supplies staff or data, performs work, pays, keeps records, and resolves disputes.' The title does not decide legal effect; read authority, operative clauses, signers, funding instrument and implementation record. Five jobs: coordinate, supply services/staff, share data, set procedures, move/reimburse money. No override of the Privacy Act or other disclosure limits.
